sloka: एतच्छ्रुत्वा शुभं वाक्यं पितामहसमीरितम् ।अङ्केनादाय वैदेहीमुत्पपात विभावसुः ।। ६.१२१.१ ।।
transliteration: etacchrutvā śubhaṁ vākyaṁ pitāmahasamīritam ।aṅkenādāya vaidehīmutpapāta vibhāvasuḥ ।। 6.121.1 ।।

translations.english: On hearing creator Brahma's address to Rama, fire god emerged picking auspicious Vaidehi in his arms.
